title: Tim Taylor shows Grant the jump room building
place_text: former aircraft building turned office complex

tellings.quote: And then he says, and then he says, oh, I don't remember, but he said, this is where the jump room was, or this is the jump, this is the story of the jump room.

plain: In 2013 a man named Timothy Taylor took a guest named Grant Cameron to an old aircraft building that had been turned into offices, and told him this was where something called the jump room had been. Cameron tells Michels about the visit himself, though he admits he does not remember Taylor's exact words: either "this is where the jump room was" or "this is the story of the jump room." He tells it as a place tied to a secret story, but what the jump room was, he does not spell out here.
